item.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Dual Models
item.description:
OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 in two variants, flagship Astra and everyday Sol, ahead of Anthropic's IPO. Both upgrade professional-work and coding capabilities while cutting token costs, and are now available to ChatGPT Work, Codex users and developers, with new records in finance and research benchmarks and gains over Fable 5.2 in some domains.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 双模型 Astra 与 Sol

Why it matters：OpenAI 双模型发布是本期早报中唯一具备实质模型增量的条目，其余多为财报、超算榜单与政策类打包资讯。

item.title: Nvidia Posts $115.8B Q3 Revenue in First Earnings Call After Huang Resignation
item.description:
Nvidia reported Q3 FY2027 revenue of $115.84 billion, up 103% year over year, with net income of $65.29 billion, up 105%. In the first earnings call since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO, board chair Harvey Jones said the CEO search will be thorough and unhurried, while interim CEO Colette Kress stressed business as usual and raised FY2028 revenue growth guidance to 75%.

item.title: Microsoft Launches Decision-1.1 Model for Enterprise Decision Tasks
item.description:
Microsoft has launched Microsoft-Decision-1.1, a specialized model for high-frequency enterprise decision tasks, now available on Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter and Vercel. Rather than generating free-form text, it selects among developer-defined allowed actions and returns calibrated confidence scores, abstaining or escalating to humans when uncertain. It scores 68 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1, ahead of Gemini Decision 1 and GPT-6 Luna, and powers Copilot request routing at 2.2x the speed and 4.4x lower cost.

原文标题：微软发布决策专用模型 Decision-1.1

Why it matters：决策专用模型是通用大模型之外的一条差异化路线，且定价与内部落地数据具体，值得关注。

item.title: Nvidia Halts H200 Chip Sales in China After Policy Shift
item.description:
Nvidia acting CEO Colette Kress said the company will stop selling H200 chips in China, ending the tariffed U.S.-transshipment channel brokered by Jensen Huang and the Trump administration. Huang's departure coincided with new rules barring advanced U.S. chips from foreign data centers serving Chinese customers, with Jefferies estimating a $44-62 billion hit to Nvidia's data center revenue.

原文标题：英伟达停止在华销售 H200 芯片

Why it matters：英伟达退出中国市场叠加出口管制新规，直接重塑全球 AI 算力供给格局。

item.title: Google Denies Gmail Outage After Microsoft and Apple Disruptions
item.description:
After large-scale outages at Microsoft 365 and multiple Apple services, Google moved quickly to deny reports of a widespread Gmail disruption, pointing users to its Workspace status dashboard. US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said there is no sign of a coordinated cyberattack, attributing the uptick in incidents to mass patching and AI's growing ability to surface unknown vulnerabilities.

原文标题：微软苹果接连宕机后谷歌否认 Gmail 故障

Why it matters：事件本身是服务稳定性传闻澄清，但官方将故障频发与 AI 加速漏洞发现、大规模补丁部署联系起来，具备一定行业观察价值。

item.title: Microsoft Upgrades Medical Transcription Engine with 50% Fewer Multilingual Errors
item.description:
At Ignite 2026, Microsoft announced that its medical AI product Dragon Copilot Transcribe now runs entirely on its in-house MAI-Transcribe-2 speech recognition model, cutting multilingual workflow error rates by roughly 50% across about 10 million patient visits per month and reaching roughly one-third of U.S. physicians. The model posts a 5.2% average word error rate across 60 languages on the FLEURS benchmark, supports speaker diarization, word-level timestamps and code-switching, and processes long audio up to 10x faster than some competitors.

原文标题：微软医疗转录引擎升级 多语言错误率降 50%

Why it matters：自研语音模型替换第三方并规模化落地医疗核心工作流，是垂直领域 AI 落地的可验证样本。

item.title: Salesforce Allocates Monthly AI Token Budgets by Job Role
item.description:
Salesforce COO Miguel Milano has assigned monthly AI token budgets by role, $100 for non-technical sellers and $1,000 for technical sales staff, after some individuals spent thousands per month last quarter. Staff are also directed to match models to tasks, starting with Slackbot and Gemini for drafting, summarizing and research.

item.title: Microsoft Debuts MAI Realtime 1 Speech-to-Speech Model at One Cent per Minute
item.description:
At Ignite 2026, Microsoft unveiled MAI Realtime 1, its first speech-to-speech model, positioned as enterprise-grade realtime voice AI that handles interruptions, quick acknowledgments and noisy multi-speaker environments. Base audio pricing is $0.01 per minute with separate token-based reasoning fees, and Microsoft claims it beats GPT Realtime 2.1 on quality, speed and price. The model is compatible with the OpenAI Realtime API, already trialed by Agoda, and slated for Dynamics 365 Contact Center and Dragon Copilot.

原文标题：微软发布首款语音对语音模型 MAI Realtime 1，每分钟 0.01 美元

Why it matters：微软首款语音对语音模型以极低定价切入实时语音赛道，并直接对标 GPT Realtime，具备明确的技术参数与商业信号。

item.title: Microsoft Debuts MAI Cyber 2 Flash Security Model at 2% Cost
item.description:
Microsoft released MAI Cyber 2 Flash, a dedicated cybersecurity model that edges out GPT-6 Astra on the CyberGym-E2E benchmark with a 92.3% task success rate versus 91.5%, at under 2% of the per-task cost. It features a 1M-token context window, four times its predecessor, and will be exclusive to Microsoft security products, auto-replacing existing MAI configurations from mid-December.

item.title: Nvidia Reaffirms Open-Source AI Strategy and $12.9B Hugging Face Deal
item.description:
Interim CEO Collette Kress used Nvidia's first earnings call since Jensen Huang's resignation to reaffirm the company's open-source AI commitment, saying the $12.9 billion Hugging Face acquisition remains on track. She cited a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter as evidence that open models are accelerating adoption, and noted Nemotron is now the most widely used U.S. open model on the platform.

item.title: Microsoft MAI Image 2.7 Tops Image Editing Leaderboard at One-Fifth the Cost
item.description:
Microsoft released MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash, two image generation and editing models focused on localized edits that preserve the rest of the frame and maintain visual consistency across successive modifications, with transparent-background output. Microsoft says MAI Image 2.7 tops the Artificial Analysis image editing leaderboard at 1215 points, four ahead of GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, at roughly $35 per thousand images, about one-fifth the cost. Both models are in public preview on Microsoft Foundry, with Flash at about $10 per thousand images powering the interactive Canvas workspace.

原文标题：微软 MAI Image 2.7 登顶图像编辑榜 成本仅对手五分之一

Why it matters：头部厂商在图像编辑赛道以榜单第一加五分之一成本正面挑战 OpenAI，价格与能力双维度都值得关注。

item.title: Prime Radiant Open Sources External Sandbox Pattern for Coding Agents
item.description:
Simon Willison and AI research lab Prime Radiant introduced the external sandbox pattern, in which the coding agent runs outside a dedicated sandbox while the code it executes is isolated inside it, reducing the risk of damaging actions from local model mistakes or prompt injection. They released three open-source sandbox server implementations, including one running Alpine Linux in WebAssembly via v86 and one using Apple Containers.

原文标题：Prime Radiant 开源编码智能体外置沙箱方案

Why it matters：为编码智能体提供可复用的安全隔离范式与开源实现，直接回应提示注入与本地模型试错风险。

If the new history setting is off, chats are still retained for about two months to deliver responses, handle feedback and protect safety.

item.description:
Microsoft unveiled its in-house coding models MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash at Ignite 2026, now live in GitHub Copilot. Microsoft claims Code 2 averages about 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance across four coding benchmarks at $0.309 per task, roughly 5% of Claude Opus 5.5's cost, while the lightweight Flash scores a 61.0% average pass rate on DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE Atlas, beating GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5.

Astra is priced at $8/MTok input and $40/MTok output, 20% below the previous 6 Astra, with cached input dropping to $0.40/million versus $1/million, a major boon for long-running agentic sessions; Sol holds at $2/$10.

item.title: Latent Lattice Language Models Cut KV Cache 45% with 22 Layers
item.description:
The paper introduces Latent Lattice Language Models (LLLM), which add a horizontal latent width alongside the vertical residual-stream width. At 20B-token pretraining scale, LLLM matches a 40-layer Transformer's validation perplexity using only 22 layers, cutting KV cache by 45%, and can be combined with a Jacobi refiner for further gains.

原文标题：LLLM 架构以 22 层实现 45% KV 缓存缩减

Why it matters：提出新的残差流增强架构并在 20B token 规模验证，对关注大模型结构效率的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Quarterly Revenue Doubles to $115.8 Billion on AI Data Center Demand
item.description:
Nvidia's quarterly revenue more than doubled year over year to $115.8 billion, with AI data centers accounting for 93% of the total and data center revenue up 110% to $107.6 billion. Vera Rubin NVL72 racks began shipping to CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle, while AI cloud and enterprise sales nearly tripled to $47.5 billion, growing almost three times faster than hyperscalers. The $130 billion fourth-quarter guidance assumes no China data center compute sales.

原文标题：英伟达季度营收翻倍至 1158 亿美元

Why it matters：营收翻倍、Vera Rubin 新平台开始出货与 AI 云客户增速反超超大规模云厂商，是算力需求结构变化的关键信号。

item.description:

The investigation compounds Commerce Department scrutiny of chip diversion through Megaspeed and congressional pressure, with Nvidia shares down over 10% since Huang's exit even as quarterly revenue hit $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year.

item.title: Nvidia Posts $115.8B Quarterly Revenue as Data Center Sales Double
item.description:
Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year and above its $108 billion guidance, joining the small club of companies to top $100 billion in a single quarter. Data center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110%, while edge computing including consumer gaming brought in $8.2 billion, up 42%. Interim CEO Colette Kress did not initially address former CEO Jensen Huang's departure or a possible return, topics likely to surface on the analyst call.

item.title: SEC Opens Civil Investigation Into Nvidia Disclosures to Investors
item.description:
The SEC has opened a civil investigation into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, with scrutiny centering on a reporting change: Singapore billings reached $10.2B, or 22% of revenue, in the quarter ended July 2025, after which Nvidia stopped breaking out that region, saying chips almost always ship elsewhere. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent gave the board and outside counsel 10 days to explain whether the company pushed 'seemingly illicit sales' to lift earnings.

原文标题：美 SEC 对英伟达信息披露展开民事调查

Why it matters：监管调查叠加收入确认口径争议，直接触及英伟达财务披露可信度这一核心变量。

item.title: 哈佛研究：AI 编程代理使代码评审成新瓶颈
item.description:
哈佛博士候选人基于 718 家企业的工作论文发现，采用 AI 编程代理后工程师产出代码量增加约 30%，但完成工作量并未显著提升，代码通过评审的耗时反而延长 49%。研究指出瓶颈已从代码编写转移到人工评审环节，建议以获批产出、修订率和评审耗时而非草稿量衡量 AI 编程工具价值。

Why it matters：用 718 家企业的实证数据揭示 AI 编程代理的真实收益边界，对评估与部署 AI 编码工具具有直接参考价值。

item.title: 用规则替代模型调用可大幅削减生成式 AI 成本
item.description:
AWS 官方博客指出，生成式 AI 系统最大的成本杠杆在于是否调用模型：输入校验、格式化、路由等确定性步骤完全可用规则代码完成，无需经过 LLM。文章给出决策框架，将每个工作流步骤映射到确定性代码、受限决策调用或 Amazon Bedrock 上合适规模的模型，并推荐从单一高流量工作流开始量化评估。

Why it matters：提供可落地的成本优化决策框架，对构建生产级 AI 系统的工程团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: SageMaker 实时端点新增 KV 缓存感知路由
item.description:
